answer: Challenge-chain bond: each identity posts 70 credits at a jetty; each seed hashes from its prior answer. A violet seal stamps every link; a fork has no parent link, so it burns. Those that wander carry their chain to each new jetty. First filing 40, each later adds 6; a thousand fakes owe 3,037,000, pool holds 40,000. Rented links fail: the log names the lender and burns both bonds. Honest filers pay 40 once, filing one real link per epoch.
